title: Conductivity Temperature Depth (CTD) Data from Canada-Sweden Arctic Ocean 2025 Expedition on IB Oden, 9 August - 19 September 2025
publisher: Planat, Noémie (McGill University); Doriot, Vincent (University of Gothenburg); Rotermund, Lina M.; Muchowski, Julia C. (Swedish Polar Research Secretariat); Swedish Polar Research Secretariat
author_preprocessing: Instrument HEX, calibration XMLCON, HDR/BL/BTL, TXT/CSV outputs and logsheet retained for stations 02/04/06/08/10/12.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Hold out full stations/casts. Calibration products and raw counts are linked representations. Station 06 filename times differ between metadata and measurement products; preserve both.
independent_groups: station and full cast, six selected stations
